data.title: report burnup
data.description: The one question burndown structurally cannot answer: was the goal missed, or did the goal grow. Scope line from sprint.task_added timestamps plus estimate changes; the journal has no sprint.task_removed, so scope removal is only visible as reassignment or cancellation and the report has to say so in a note. Detail in docs/research/reports-discovery-2026-09.md, addendum.
